## What changed and why?

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if applicable.

## Scope

Which roadmap phase does this support? Keep unrelated changes separate.

## Validation

List the checks performed and their results. For documentation changes, include link, formatting and diagram review as appropriate. For runtime changes, distinguish automated tests from live VM or cluster testing.

## Limitations or migration

Describe known gaps, compatibility changes and any user action needed. Write "None" when appropriate.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] I read the contribution guide and kept this change focused.
- [ ] I updated relevant documentation and included appropriate validation.
- [ ] I excluded credentials, generated state and private runtime logs.
